Predicates:

NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.

BulgarianSettlement(y) ::: y is a Bulgarian settlement.

Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.

LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.

PartOf(y, z) ::: y is part of z.

Premises:

NamedAfter(barutinCove, barutin) ∧ BulgarianSettlement(barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.

LocatedIn(barutinCove, snowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.

PartOf(snowIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ PartOf(greenwichIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ PartOf(deceptionIsland, southShetlandIslands) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island.

PartOf(southShetlandIslands, antarctica) ::: The South Shetland Islands are considered part of Antarctica.

∀x ∀y ∀z ((LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ PartOf(y, z)) → LocatedIn(x, z)) ::: If A is located in B and B is located in C, then A is located in C.

Conclusion:

∃x (Cove(x) ∧ LocatedIn(x, antarctica) ∧ ∃y (BulgarianSettlement(y) ∧ NamedAfter(x, y))) ::: There is at least one cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria.
